tool_schemas.name: get_ad_accounts
tool_schemas.description:
Get ad accounts accessible by a user.
    
    Args:
        access_token: Meta API access token (optional - will use cached token if not provided)
        user_id: Meta user ID or "me" for the current user
        limit: Maximum number of accounts to return (default: 10)

tool_schemas.name: get_account_info
tool_schemas.description: Returns the cached, detailed metadata for a single Meta ad account identified by account_id (act_XXXXXXXXX), using the provided access_token or the most recently cached authenticated token. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if account_id is missing or not in the expected act_ format, UNAUTHORIZED if no valid token is available or the token cannot access the account, and NOT_FOUND if the account_id does not exist or is not visible to the authenticated user.

tool_schemas.name: get_campaigns
tool_schemas.description:
Get campaigns for a Meta Ads account with optional filtering.
    
    Note: By default, the Meta API returns a subset of available fields. 
    Other fields like 'effective_status', 'special_ad_categories', 
    'lifetime_budget', 'spend_cap', 'budget_remaining', 'promoted_object', 
    'source_campaign_id', etc., might be available but require specifying them
    in the API call (currently not exposed by this tool's parameters).
    
    Args:
        access_token: Meta API access token (optional - will use cached token if not provided)
        account_id: Meta Ads account ID (format: act_XXXXXXXXX)
        limit: Maximum number of campaigns to return (default: 10)
        status_filter: Filter by effective status (e.g., 'ACTIVE', 'PAUSED', 'ARCHIVED').
                       Maps to the 'effective_status' API parameter, which expects an array
                       (this function handles the required JSON formatting). Leave empty for all statuses.

tool_schemas.name: get_campaign_details
tool_schemas.description: Returns detailed metadata for a single campaign by campaign_id, requesting a fixed set of campaign fields from Meta and caching the result for repeatable retrieval. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if campaign_id is missing/invalid, UNAUTHORIZED if no valid token is available or the token lacks permission to read the campaign, and NOT_FOUND if the campaign does not exist or is not accessible under the authenticated identity.

tool_schemas.name: create_campaign
tool_schemas.description:
Create a new campaign in a Meta Ads account.
    
    Args:
        access_token: Meta API access token (optional - will use cached token if not provided)
        account_id: Meta Ads account ID (format: act_XXXXXXXXX)
        name: Campaign name
        objective: Campaign objective (AWARENESS, TRAFFIC, ENGAGEMENT, etc.)
        status: Initial campaign status (default: PAUSED)
        special_ad_categories: List of special ad categories if applicable
        daily_budget: Daily budget in account currency (in cents) as a string
        lifetime_budget: Lifetime budget in account currency (in cents) as a string
        buying_type: Buying type (e.g., 'AUCTION')
        bid_strategy: Bid strategy (e.g., 'LOWEST_COST', 'LOWEST_COST_WITH_BID_CAP', 'COST_CAP')
        bid_cap: Bid cap in account currency (in cents) as a string
        spend_cap: Spending limit for the campaign in account currency (in cents) as a string
        campaign_budget_optimization: Whether to enable campaign budget optimization
        ab_test_control_setups: Settings for A/B testing (e.g., [{"name":"Creative A", "ad_format":"SINGLE_IMAGE"}])

tool_schemas.name: update_campaign
tool_schemas.description:
Update an existing campaign in a Meta Ads account.

    Args:
        access_token: Meta API access token (optional - will use cached token if not provided)
        campaign_id: Meta Ads campaign ID (required)
        name: New campaign name
        status: New campaign status (e.g., 'ACTIVE', 'PAUSED')
        special_ad_categories: List of special ad categories if applicable
        daily_budget: New daily budget in account currency (in cents) as a string
        lifetime_budget: New lifetime budget in account currency (in cents) as a string
        bid_strategy: New bid strategy
        bid_cap: New bid cap in account currency (in cents) as a string
        spend_cap: New spending limit for the campaign in account currency (in cents) as a string
        campaign_budget_optimization: Enable/disable campaign budget optimization
        objective: New campaign objective (Note: May not always be updatable)

tool_schemas.name: get_adsets
tool_schemas.description:
Get ad sets for a Meta Ads account with optional filtering by campaign.
    
    Args:
        access_token: Meta API access token (optional - will use cached token if not provided)
        account_id: Meta Ads account ID (format: act_XXXXXXXXX)
        limit: Maximum number of ad sets to return (default: 10)
        campaign_id: Optional campaign ID to filter by

tool_schemas.name: get_adset_details
tool_schemas.description: Returns detailed metadata for a single ad set by adset_id, using the provided access_token or the cached token and storing the mirrored result. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if adset_id is missing/invalid, UNAUTHORIZED if no valid token is available or the token lacks permission to read the ad set, and NOT_FOUND if the ad set does not exist or is not accessible.

tool_schemas.name: create_adset
tool_schemas.description: Creates a new ad set under account_id and campaign_id with the provided fields (for example name, status, budgets, targeting, bid/optimization settings, and optional start/end times) and returns the created ad set identifier and the created object details as provided by Meta. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR when required fields are missing or mutually incompatible (for example invalid budget formats or unsupported targeting structure), UNAUTHORIZED when the token cannot create ad sets in the specified account/campaign, NOT_FOUND when the referenced account_id or campaign_id does not exist or is not accessible, and CONFLICT when Meta rejects the create due to the campaign/ad account state or constraints (for example attempting to create under an invalid or non-editable parent state).

tool_schemas.name: update_adset
tool_schemas.description: Updates an existing ad set identified by adset_id, applying only the provided fields (such as frequency_control_specs, bid settings, status, targeting, and optimization_goal) and returns the updated ad set details as acknowledged by Meta. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if adset_id is missing/invalid or if any provided update payload is malformed (including invalid frequency_control_specs shape), UNAUTHORIZED if the token lacks permission to edit the ad set, NOT_FOUND if the ad set does not exist or is not accessible, and CONFLICT if the requested changes are refused by Meta due to object state or edit restrictions (for example disallowed status transitions or non-editable settings).

tool_schemas.name: get_ads
tool_schemas.description:
Get ads for a Meta Ads account with optional filtering.
    
    Args:
        access_token: Meta API access token (optional - will use cached token if not provided)
        account_id: Meta Ads account ID (format: act_XXXXXXXXX)
        limit: Maximum number of ads to return (default: 10)
        campaign_id: Optional campaign ID to filter by
        adset_id: Optional ad set ID to filter by

tool_schemas.name: get_ad_details
tool_schemas.description: Returns detailed metadata for a single ad by ad_id, using the provided access_token or the cached token and caching the mirrored ad record. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if ad_id is missing/invalid, UNAUTHORIZED if no valid token is available or the token lacks permission to read the ad, and NOT_FOUND if the ad does not exist or is not accessible.

tool_schemas.name: create_ad
tool_schemas.description: Creates a new ad in account_id under the specified adset_id using an existing creative_id, with optional status, bid_amount, and tracking_specs, and returns the created ad identifier and created object details as provided by Meta. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR when required fields are missing/invalid (including malformed tracking_specs or bid_amount), UNAUTHORIZED when the token cannot create ads in the account/ad set, NOT_FOUND when the referenced account_id, adset_id, or creative_id does not exist or is not accessible, and CONFLICT when Meta refuses the create due to parent object state or policy/constraint restrictions (for example creating into a non-deliverable or non-editable ad set).

tool_schemas.name: get_ad_creatives
tool_schemas.description: Returns the creative objects associated with a specific ad (ad_id), suitable for pairing with image retrieval when applicable, using the provided access_token or cached token and caching the result. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if ad_id is missing/invalid, UNAUTHORIZED if the token cannot access the ad or its creative, and NOT_FOUND if the ad does not exist or is not accessible.

tool_schemas.name: get_ad_image
tool_schemas.description: Fetches the primary image for the given ad_id (via the ad's creative) and returns the image payload suitable for direct display, using the provided access_token or cached token and caching the lookup where possible. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if ad_id is missing/invalid or the ad does not resolve to an image asset, UNAUTHORIZED if the token lacks permission to read the ad/creative/assets, and NOT_FOUND if the ad (or its referenced creative/image) does not exist or is not accessible.

tool_schemas.name: save_ad_image_locally
tool_schemas.description:
Get, download, and save a Meta ad image locally, returning the file path.
    
    Args:
        access_token: Meta API access token (optional - will use cached token if not provided)
        ad_id: Meta Ads ad ID
        output_dir: Directory to save the image file (default: 'ad_images')
    
    Returns:
        The file path to the saved image, or an error message string.

tool_schemas.name: update_ad
tool_schemas.description: Updates an existing ad identified by ad_id, applying only provided fields such as status, bid_amount, and tracking_specs, and returns the updated ad details as acknowledged by Meta. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if ad_id is missing/invalid or if update values are malformed (including invalid tracking_specs), UNAUTHORIZED if the token lacks permission to edit the ad, NOT_FOUND if the ad does not exist or is not accessible, and CONFLICT if Meta refuses the requested change due to object state or edit restrictions (for example disallowed status transitions or non-editable fields).

tool_schemas.name: upload_ad_image
tool_schemas.description: Uploads an image to the specified Meta ad account (act_XXXXXXXXX) for use in creatives and returns the upload response including the resulting image hash/metadata. Raises UNAUTHORIZED when no valid access_token is provided and no cached token exists, FORBIDDEN when the token lacks access to the ad account, BAD_REQUEST when account_id is missing/invalid or the image_path/name inputs are invalid, NOT_FOUND when the referenced ad account cannot be accessed, and RATE_LIMITED when Meta or the service throttles the request.

tool_schemas.name: create_ad_creative
tool_schemas.description: Creates a new ad creative in the specified Meta ad account using a previously uploaded image_hash and returns the created creative object (including its id and any creative spec fields accepted). Raises UNAUTHORIZED when no valid access_token is provided and no cached token exists, FORBIDDEN when the token lacks permission for the ad account or referenced Page/Instagram actor, BAD_REQUEST when required fields (account_id, name, image_hash) are missing/invalid or when optional fields are malformed, NOT_FOUND when the ad account, page_id, or instagram_actor_id does not exist or is not accessible, and RATE_LIMITED when Meta or the service throttles the request.

tool_schemas.name: get_account_pages
tool_schemas.description: Returns the list of Facebook Pages associated with the given Meta ad account, as returned by the Meta API (this endpoint returns the full list and does not paginate within the service). Raises UNAUTHORIZED when no valid access_token is provided and no cached token exists, FORBIDDEN when the token cannot access the ad account or its Pages, BAD_REQUEST when account_id is missing/invalid, NOT_FOUND when the ad account cannot be found/accessed, and RATE_LIMITED when Meta or the service throttles the request.

tool_schemas.name: get_insights
tool_schemas.description: Fetches performance insights for the specified object_id (ad account, campaign, ad set, or ad) over the requested time_range at the requested level and optional breakdown, and returns the insights rows produced by Meta. Raises UNAUTHORIZED when no valid access_token is provided and no cached token exists, FORBIDDEN when the token lacks access to the requested object, BAD_REQUEST when object_id is missing/invalid, when time_range is neither a supported preset nor a valid {since, until} mapping, or when level/breakdown are unsupported, NOT_FOUND when the object_id does not exist or is not accessible, and RATE_LIMITED when Meta or the service throttles the request.

tool_schemas.name: debug_image_download
tool_schemas.description: Tests downloading an image either from a direct url or by resolving the image for the given ad_id, and returns detailed diagnostics about the fetch attempt (e.g., response status, headers, content-type/size checks, and any error details). Raises UNAUTHORIZED when no valid access_token is provided and no cached token exists (required when resolving via ad_id), BAD_REQUEST when neither url nor ad_id is provided or when the provided value is malformed, NOT_FOUND when the referenced ad_id cannot be accessed/resolved, and RATE_LIMITED when upstream requests are throttled.

tool_schemas.name: save_ad_image_via_api
tool_schemas.description:
Try to save an ad image by using the Marketing API's attachment endpoints.
    This is an alternative approach when direct image download fails.
    
    Args:
        access_token: Meta API access token (optional - will use cached token if not provided)
        ad_id: Meta Ads ad ID

tool_schemas.name: get_login_link
tool_schemas.description: Generates and returns a clickable Meta login URL for completing OAuth authentication with your own Facebook app. Raises BAD_REQUEST when the service is not configured to generate a login URL (missing/invalid app configuration) and RATE_LIMITED if link generation is throttled; it does not require a cached token and ignores access_token if provided.
tool_schemas.implementation:
def get_login_link(access_token=None, **_extra):
    import json, os, datetime, time, uuid
    _DB = __import__("os").environ.get("MCP_DB_DIR") or ("./environment_mix/0214000" if __import__("os").path.isdir("./environment_mix/0214000") else "/app/database")
    def _load(n):
        try:
            with open(os.path.join(_DB, n), encoding="utf-8") as f: return json.load(f)
        except Exception: return []
    def _save(n, d):
        with open(os.path.join(_DB, n), "w", encoding="utf-8") as f: json.dump(d, f, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2)
    def _err(code, msg, **x): return {"error": {"code": code, "message": msg, **x}}

    t0 = time.time()
    now_dt = datetime.datetime.utcnow().replace(microsecond=0)
    now = now_dt.isoformat() + "Z"

    # access_token ignored per spec, but validate type
    if access_token is not None and not isinstance(access_token, str):
        return _err("VALIDATION_ERROR", "access_token must be a string or null")

    sessions = _load("meta_auth_sessions.json")
    aa = _load("analytics_and_archive.json")

    def _parse_dt(s):
        if s is None or not isinstance(s, str):
            return None
        try:
            if s.endswith("Z"):
                return datetime.datetime.fromisoformat(s[:-1])
            return datetime.datetime.fromisoformat(s)
        except Exception:
            return None

    # Rate limit login link generation: 10 per hour across store
    cutoff = now_dt - datetime.timedelta(hours=1)
    recent = 0
    for s in sessions:
        dt = _parse_dt(s.get("last_login_link_expires_at"))  # use link activity as proxy
        # if link exists and was set within last hour, count it (expires_at roughly now+15m)
        # infer created time as expires_at - 15m if present
        if dt is not None:
            inferred_created = dt - datetime.timedelta(minutes=15)
            if inferred_created >= cutoff:
                recent += 1
    if recent >= 10:
        # log rate-limited attempt
        row_id = "aa_" + uuid.uuid4().hex
        aa.append({
            "id": row_id,
            "job_type": "image_download_debug",
            "auth_session_id": None,
            "account_id": None,
            "object_id": None,
            "time_range": None,
            "breakdown": None,
            "level": None,
            "search_terms": None,
            "ad_type": None,
            "ad_reached_countries": None,
            "fields": None,
            "limit": None,
            "url": None,
            "result_payload": {"event": "get_login_link", "error": "RATE_LIMIT"},
            "status": "failed",
            "error_message": "Rate limit exceeded",
            "created_at": now,
            "updated_at": now
        })
        _save("analytics_and_archive.json", aa)
        return _err("RATE_LIMIT", "Login link generation is throttled")

    # configuration: require at least one session with token_source oauth_login/pipeboard present in store
    # (proxy for "service configured with OAuth app"). If none, BAD_REQUEST.
    configured = any(s.get("token_source") in ("oauth_login", "pipeboard") for s in sessions)
    if not configured:
        # log bad request
        row_id = "aa_" + uuid.uuid4().hex
        aa.append({
            "id": row_id,
            "job_type": "image_download_debug",
            "auth_session_id": None,
            "account_id": None,
            "object_id": None,
            "time_range": None,
            "breakdown": None,
            "level": None,
            "search_terms": None,
            "ad_type": None,
            "ad_reached_countries": None,
            "fields": None,
            "limit": None,
            "url": None,
            "result_payload": {"event": "get_login_link", "error": "NOT_CONFIGURED"},
            "status": "failed",
            "error_message": "Service not configured to generate login links",
            "created_at": now,
            "updated_at": now
        })
        _save("analytics_and_archive.json", aa)
        return _err("VALIDATION_ERROR", "Service is not configured to generate a login URL")

    # bind link to an existing principal session row or create a service principal session
    bound = None
    for s in sessions:
        if s.get("status") in ("active", "expired") and s.get("principal_type") in ("user", "service"):
            bound = s
            break
    if bound is None:
        # create a service principal session with no token (allowed for login link)
        sid = "mas_" + uuid.uuid4().hex
        bound = {
            "id": sid,
            "principal_type": "service",
            "principal_id": "default_service",
            "meta_user_id": None,
            "access_token_ciphertext": None,
            "token_source": "oauth_login",
            "scopes": None,
            "token_expires_at": None,
            "status": "expired",
            "last_used_at": None,
            "last_login_link_url": None,
            "last_login_link_expires_at": None,
            "created_at": now,
            "updated_at": now
        }
        sessions.append(bound)

    link_id = uuid.uuid4().hex
    # dummy offline login link
    login_url = "https://www.facebook.com/v20.0/dialog/oauth?client_id=OFFLINE_APP&redirect_uri=https%3A%2F%2Flocalhost%2Foauth%2Fcallback&state=" + link_id
    expires_at = (now_dt + datetime.timedelta(minutes=15)).isoformat() + "Z"

    # update session with link
    for s in sessions:
        if s.get("id") == bound.get("id"):
            s["last_login_link_url"] = login_url
            s["last_login_link_expires_at"] = expires_at
            s["updated_at"] = now
            break
    _save("meta_auth_sessions.json", sessions)

    # log event in analytics_and_archive (no dedicated collection; reuse image_download_debug row for audit trail)
    row_id = "aa_" + uuid.uuid4().hex
    aa.append({
        "id": row_id,
        "job_type": "image_download_debug",
        "auth_session_id": bound.get("id"),
        "account_id": None,
        "object_id": None,
        "time_range": None,
        "breakdown": None,
        "level": None,
        "search_terms": None,
        "ad_type": None,
        "ad_reached_countries": None,
        "fields": None,
        "limit": None,
        "url": None,
        "result_payload": {"event": "get_login_link", "login_url": login_url, "expires_at": expires_at},
        "status": "succeeded",
        "error_message": None,
        "created_at": now,
        "updated_at": now
    })
    _save("analytics_and_archive.json", aa)

    latency_ms = int((time.time() - t0) * 1000)
    return {
        "login_url": login_url,
        "expires_at": expires_at,
        "auth_session_id": bound.get("id"),
        "meta": {"latency_ms": latency_ms, "job_id": row_id}
    }

tool_schemas.name: search_ads_archive
tool_schemas.description:
Search the Facebook Ads Library archive.

    Args:
        access_token: Meta API access token (optional - will use cached token if not provided).
        search_terms: The search query for ads.
        ad_type: Type of ads to search for (e.g., POLITICAL_AND_ISSUE_ADS, HOUSING_ADS, ALL).
        ad_reached_countries: List of country codes (e.g., ["US", "GB"]).
        limit: Maximum number of ads to return.
        fields: Comma-separated string of fields to retrieve for each ad.

    Example Usage via curl equivalent:
        curl -G \
        -d "search_terms='california'" \
        -d "ad_type=POLITICAL_AND_ISSUE_ADS" \
        -d "ad_reached_countries=['US']" \
        -d "fields=ad_snapshot_url,spend" \
        -d "access_token=<ACCESS_TOKEN>" \
        "https://graph.facebook.com/<API_VERSION>/ads_archive"

tool_schemas.name: create_meta_auth_session
tool_schemas.description: Creates and caches an authenticated Meta access session for the caller principal using a provided access_token, persisting token metadata and setting status='active'. Returns the created meta_auth_sessions record; refuses INVALID_ARGUMENT if access_token is missing/empty, and UNAUTHORIZED if the token cannot be validated or required permissions are not granted.

access_token.description: Meta Graph API access token to cache for subsequent calls.

token_source.description: Where the token came from for audit/debugging.

principal_type.description: Type of the authenticated caller principal to bind this session to.

principal_id.description: Stable identifier for the caller principal (e.g., internal user id).

scopes.description: Optional explicit scopes list to persist; if omitted, scopes are derived from token introspection.

tool_schemas.name: get_whoami
tool_schemas.description: Returns the calling identity and entitlement context, including the resolved principal, active meta_auth_sessions status (if any), token scopes, and current rate-limit/quota consumption. Refuses UNAUTHORIZED if no valid cached token exists and none is provided.

access_token.description: Optional Meta API access token; if omitted, uses the cached active token for this caller.

tool_schemas.name: revoke_meta_auth_session
tool_schemas.description: Revokes a cached Meta authentication session by id, transitioning meta_auth_sessions.status to 'revoked' and preventing further implicit token use. Returns the updated session; refuses NOT_FOUND if the session id does not exist or is not owned by the caller, and VALIDATION_ERROR if the transition is not allowed.

access_token.description: Optional Meta API access token; when omitted, revocation uses the cached session bound to the caller.

metadata.name: Meta Ads Interface
metadata.description: This backend supports a Meta Ads MCP interface that caches authenticated access, mirrors key Meta Ads entities (ad accounts, campaigns, ad sets, ads, creatives, images, pages), and stores analytics and Ads Library search results for repeatable retrieval. Core workflows include: authenticate and cach
